text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre!
Orfevre is making her move!
Is she truly the one to conquer the Arima Kinen?!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah--!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's it, that's it!
Orfevre! You're my new sense of justice!
Look, this is common sense, and—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Haa—haa...
Am I... going to lose...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Even Gold Ship-san stepped up for my sake.
Everyone was trying to protect me, and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(I couldn't become "justice prevails,"
—and I...—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...Because Orfevre-san was there?
If Orfevre-san... hadn't been there...?)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —That's WRONG!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
My existence won't be denied!
Because I—I have a rival to compete against now!
Because I have Orfe-san!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—Her fighting spirit burns so intensely,
growing stronger by the moment!!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Tell them! Tell them what our very existence creates and nurtures! And the future that may be born from it!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —The value of what justice can protect!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Uwooooooaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno!! Fenomeno holds on!
Incredible, incredible! In a race like this,
against a lineup like this—

text_block_list.name: Spectators C & D
text_block_list.text: …………――Intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
...N-No.
No, no. I'm--

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? I wonder who's gonna win!?
Orfe!? Or Fenomeno!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...! Incredible, amazing!
—I want to keep watching races like this forever!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno takes first place!!
She conquered Orfevre in the Arima Kinen!
What a sensational finish to the year!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Hah, hah—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Fenomeno won.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
He really won! Fenomeno won!
He actually beat Orfevre!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Ah, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Do you want...
to see more?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"To see a greater variety of futures...
Futures nurtured through all manner of existences.
—Don't all of you feel the same?"

text_block_list.name: Spectators A & B
text_block_list.text: I wanna seeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators C & D
text_block_list.text: ...I want to see it...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You were the one who made me scatter.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ngh, Orfe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Are you satisfied?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I am satisfied.
Satisfied that I wished to defeat you,
and grew into someone capable of claiming that victory.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Then let me ask you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: For what purpose do you win?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: For the sake of what I want to protect.

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno!!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno!
You're so amazing! You're so strong!!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so cool, though! Golshi!
Orfe! E-very-one was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Golshi's definitely my absolute favorite!
Watching her is just so thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
...—I see.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It's fine to look up to her. It's fine to love her.
It's okay to have all sorts of viewpoints, and it's okay for all kinds of people to exist.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"You may hate me instead.
You don't even have to acknowledge me.
But please, do not rob me of my existence."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Because we all have distinct personalities,
we can meet, grow,
and reach a variety of futures."

text_block_list.name: Child in Black Hat
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh!

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text: —Well, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Child in Red T-Shirt
text_block_list.text:
"I said some awful things to you.
I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Our future is bright, sir!
And it's only going to get even brighter!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I must continue to do my best
as an ally of justice!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...And?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What is the meaning of this,
Golshi-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...An apologetic pose.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I'm gonna bring
Sacabambaspis back to life! Revive...! Resurrect...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: THAAAAT'S ENOOOOOUGH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the future continues to grow.
From here on out, too. Together with someone.
